Name: Starksouls
Author: FenrirAsonda
Description:
[code]
[/code]﻿﻿My first mod! This mod makes the farmer's health and stamina persist/carry-over to the next day. Make your health/stamina ﻿mods feel more relevant with the vanilla regen disabled! Make food have a daily role in restoring health and energy!
[size=5]
﻿Install
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5] ﻿How to use[/size]
﻿Edit the config file or use Generic Config Menu Mod to adjust values.

[list]
[*]Health/Stamina Debuff Enabled: Replaces the regen you get from sleeping and replaces it with a regen % of your choice. 
[*]Missing Health % Restored: Customize how much of the missing health is restored.
﻿(i.e: 0 for none of it, 50 for half of it, 100 for full regen)[*]Health % on Death: Customize how much of your max health you wake up with after falling unconscious. 
﻿(Adjust carefully! A number between 1-100, a 0 would mean you wake up dead!)[*]Missing Stamina % Restored: Customize how much of the missing stamina is restored.
﻿(i.e: 0 for none of it, 50 for half of it, 100 for full regen)[*]Stamina % on Pass-Out: Customize how much of your max stamina you wake up with after falling unconscious. 
﻿(Adjust carefully! A number between 1-100, a 0 would mean you wake up exhausted!)[/list]
[size=5] ﻿Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Affects only those with the mod installed.
[*]No Known Mod Conflicts*
*No known mod conflicts, but a mixture of settings can create an unintended experience. If you have mods that cause you to quickly lose health and stamina you can end up in a viscious cycle of "Deathlooping" your farmer.[*]Report any issues in bugs tab.*
**Bear with me, as this is my first mod and I'm a busy college student :P. Any fixes needed will take some time.[/list]
